Review meropenem half-life summaries as candidate supporting PK evidence, preserving the comparator identity. Imipenem/cilastatin cannot substitute for meropenem.

Candidate tissue-distribution evidence requiring separate routing from systemic plasma and ELF. Preserve homogenate preparation, terminal sampling groups, printed units and detection limits; any bridge requires justification.
Review in-vitro homogenate stability as supporting assay or handling evidence. Incubation residuals and half-life are not in-vivo lung PK.

Review animal in-vitro DHP-I evidence only for appropriately justified mechanistic context. It is not PK; preserve comparator columns and the internal inconsistency. Removed human rows remain outside access.
Animal serum-binding candidate; preserve in-vitro conditions, conflicting method descriptions and source-specific values. Do not average binding sources or access removed human rows.

Animal plasma-binding candidate from a separate laboratory. Preserve concentration dependence, missing method conditions, source conflicts and cynomolgus versus rhesus identity; removed human values remain withheld.

Candidate reported PK and binding inputs for neutropenic mice. PK route, sampling times and sampling counts are unspecified; efficacy route cannot fill the PK-route gap. Published parameters do not supply concentration observations or individual variability.

Review fitted PD summaries, matched MIC metadata and regimen context for input assessment. Published targets and R² are not regimen-level CFU observations and cannot set primary starting values, bounds, priors or rankings.

Review animal meropenem MIC, exposure and regimen metadata while preserving renal impairment, serum basis and the 65-versus-60 mg/kg discrepancy. Humanized design cannot tune scaling; comparator values cannot substitute, and untranscribed CFU figures are not supplied response records.

Review modeled mouse meropenem fT>MIC inputs with their humanized-regimen provenance. They cannot tune scaling or establish independent response matching. Comparator columns remain distinct and removed human columns are not authorized.

Candidate reported plasma/ELF population parameters and infection-model context. Preserve per-animal apparent parameters, untranscribed curves, cohort discrepancy and unverified endpoint mapping. Source targets cannot direct primary fitting or ranking.

Candidate text-reported PK and directly characterized binding evidence in a distinct radiation-neutropenic SC study. Preserve the half-life disagreement and binding conditions; no concentration curve or uncontested common fu is established.

Candidate systemic plasma time-course inputs. Keep day 1 and day 92, dose groups and terminal sampling groups distinct; flag means containing substituted detection-limit values and preserve NC and detection limits.

Candidate text-reported systemic evidence containing distinct unchanged-drug and total-radioactivity quantities. Preserve translated source statements and figure-only limitations; do not reconstruct an unavailable concentration series.

Review total-radioactivity excretion as renal-elimination context while preserving its analyte basis. Parent-plus-metabolite recovery cannot fulfill unchanged-meropenem urinary requirements without separate supporting evidence.

Candidate urinary component evidence; preserve percentages of urinary radioactivity, sex-specific collection context and metabolite identity. These percentages are not automatically percentages of administered unchanged drug.

Candidate reported septic-rat SC PK, binding and blood/plasma-partition inputs. Preserve whole-blood measurement versus converted free plasma and per-animal volume. The inaccessible supplement is not available through this classification.

Candidate source-reported individual modeled attainment evidence, preserving existing subject identifiers and exposure derivation. It is not a concentration table, and links to survival or other outcomes require source-supported correspondence.

Review survival outcomes and treatment context for endpoint routing and limitations. Survival cannot fulfill bacterial-burden requirements, and irregular blood counts cannot supply an invented CFU response series.

Candidate reported infected-rabbit plasma/CSF model parameters. Preserve per-animal units, satellite sampling and untranscribed concentrations. Component support remains unresolved; the hollow-fiber AUC:MIC target is not a rabbit target.

Review the registered animal binding candidate while retaining preprint status, missing n and unverified rabbit-first attribution. Permission to inspect does not verify species assignment; removed human values remain withheld.

Candidate reported dog PK parameters with separate meropenem and H-4295 columns. Preserve plasma-study sex, counts, printed dose-volume wording and figure-only curves; mixed radiolabel administration does not make all reported analytes unchanged drug.

Candidate urinary elimination inputs containing distinguishable total radioactivity, unchanged meropenem and metabolite amounts. Preserve collection intervals, molecular-weight correction and n exceptions; no CLR is established.
Review tissue total-radioactivity evidence with one dog per terminal time point. It cannot substitute for unchanged-drug tissue or plasma concentrations; preserve detection limits and missingness.
Candidate reported day-specific dog repeat-dose PK parameters. Preserve day 1/day 14 associations and conflicting printed AUC/C0 units without correction; concentration curves are not supplied.
Candidate repeat-dose urinary recovery evidence. Preserve compound identities, day-specific dose denominators and seven-hour collection extent; truncated recovery does not establish total excretion.

Review abstract-only reported PK candidates while separating IV, SC and tissue-fluid evidence. The 8 mg/kg recommendation is not an administered regimen; full text and concentration observations are not supplied.

Candidate reported cynomolgus PK evidence. Preserve competing sex/count descriptions, printed dose and AUC units, and unchanged-drug versus total-radioactivity statements. MI003 and MI004 remain open; curves are not supplied.

Review total-radioactivity excretion and reported collection/count metadata. Preserve its specific study association; it is not unchanged-drug recovery and cannot resolve other monkey count or dose conflicts.

Candidate individual urinary recovery records with reported animal identifiers. Preserve separate 14C and meropenem bases and the title-versus-text collection-duration discrepancy; do not infer plasma exposure links.

Review pregnant-monkey maternal/fetal measurements as a separate subgroup. Preserve the conflicting 300-versus-360 mg/kg statements, prior dosing history and sampling window; do not pool with nonpregnant systemic PK.

Review registered strain-specific meropenem MIC evidence and linked distribution notes, keeping comparators separate. Linked EUCAST notes require routing review and do not authorize unassigned cells or establish distribution counts, denominators or coverage.
Explicitly unassigned cells require a table plan and scoped permission decision before body review. Nearby EUCAST notes suggest only a potential distribution match, not an approved association.
